summary.description: One or two sentences: what the requested change is, in your own words.

approach.description: How you would implement it and why, in a short paragraph.

files.description: Files you expect to create or change.

acceptanceCriteria.description: What must be true when the change is done, each specific enough to check, and how it is checked. From the acceptance criteria in the request, or proposed by you when it has none.

criterion.description: One observable outcome, for example: GET /tasks lists open overdue tasks first.

check.description: How it is checked: the test that will cover it, or the command or manual step when a test cannot.

risks.description: What could go wrong or needs care (data, security, compatibility).

questions.description: Decisions only the requester can make. Empty when nothing is unclear.

readyToBuild.description: True only when there are no open questions and the plan can be built as written.
